lastCompletedStory.title: Add pure argv builders for planner and auditor worker panes

nextStoryContext: US-003 added src/supervisor/plan-argv.ts with buildPlannerWorkerArgv and buildAuditorWorkerArgv. Both are pure argv builders mirroring the implementer/reviewer pattern: workerEnvPrefix() + claude --permission-mode --session-id --model --agent '<prompt>'. No -p, no --output-format. 30 tests in test/supervisor/plan/plan-argv.test.ts. The next story (US-004) should add the deterministic plan pre-flight in TS.
